description: React component for a channel move submenu in Mattermost, managing channel categorization and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleMoveToCategory
methods.description: Dispatches action to move a channel to a specified category.

methods.name: handleMoveToNewCategory
methods.description: Opens modal to create a new category and add channels.

methods.name: createSubmenuItemsForCategoryArray
methods.description: Creates submenu items for each category, including special labels for favorites and channels.

methods.name: filterCategoriesBasedOnChannelType
methods.description: Filters categories based on whether the channel is a DM or GM.

methods.name: getMoveToCategorySubmenuItems
methods.description: Generates submenu items based on current channel and selection context.
